name: Telegram Bridge
description: Chat with your Orca bots from Telegram, on any device: one Telegram bot per Orca bot, access lists and roles, groups, voice messages, files both ways and an audit trail. No server or webhook.

cover.alt: Telegram Bridge: a paper plane and an orca linked by a glowing message path

screenshots.alt: Setup tab of the Telegram panel with one bridge card: bot name, active toggle, people, groups and voice
Bridge editor: bot token, who can talk, people and groups, group mode, voice messages and advanced settings
Roles editor: checkboxes for what a role may do and an extra prompt for the Orca bot

statusBarItems.tooltip: Telegram Bridge status (click to open the panel)

settings.title: Enable Telegram Polling
settings.description: Legacy (read once to create Bridge 1; edit bridges in the Telegram panel). Keep polling Telegram for incoming messages while Orca is running.

settings.title: Default Orca Bot
settings.description: Legacy (read once to create Bridge 1; edit bridges in the Telegram panel). Default Orca bot name to route Telegram messages to (leave blank for auto: use the first available bot).

settings.title: Allowed Telegram IDs
settings.description: Legacy (read once to create Bridge 1; edit bridges in the Telegram panel). Leave empty to let everyone use the bot. Add Telegram user IDs or group IDs (negative, e.g. -1001234567890), separated by commas, to allow only them.

settings.title: HTTP Proxy URL
settings.description: Legacy (read once to create Bridge 1; edit bridges in the Telegram panel). Optional HTTP proxy for api.telegram.org (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890).

settings.title: Reply Timeout (seconds)
settings.description: Legacy (read once to create Bridge 1; edit bridges in the Telegram panel). Maximum seconds to wait for an Orca bot reply.

settings.title: Sync Orca Messages to Telegram
settings.description: Legacy (read once to create Bridge 1; edit bridges in the Telegram panel). Forward messages sent in Orca and bot replies from bound chats back to Telegram.

settings.title: Telegram Reply Language
settings.description: Legacy (read once to create Bridge 1; edit bridges in the Telegram panel). Language of the bridge's own Telegram replies and command menu: en (English), pt-BR (Português do Brasil) or zh-CN (中文). Bot replies are not translated.

settings.title: Debug Logging
settings.description: Record detailed debug entries (Telegram and Orca CLI calls with timings, dispatch steps, swallowed errors) in the Logs tab. Tokens are redacted.
